subject.title: Feature Request: Masked Secrets - Prevent Agent from Accessing Raw API Keys

question: Should OpenClaw extend its trust model with an agent-blind credential broker for authorized tool and command capabilities?
rationale: Current documentation explicitly disclaims process isolation, so the requested guarantee requires deliberate security and product intent plus a permanent core/plugin contract.

options.title: Add capability broker
options.body: Build on SecretRefs with least-privilege dispatch-time injection, a narrow credential-provider plugin API, and end-to-end secret-egress proof.

options.title: Keep current trust model
options.body: Document SecretRefs as storage and egress hardening only, and support OS isolation, external proxies, or credential-vault plugins for agent-blind use.

recommendation.title: Add capability broker
recommendation.body: Build on SecretRefs with least-privilege dispatch-time injection, a narrow credential-provider plugin API, and end-to-end secret-egress proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This team owns the affected secret, auth, sandbox, and security documentation boundaries.
